content.subject: Need help responding to the other side's brief
content.body:
Hi team,

I hope you all had a good weekend. I wanted to follow up on the brief that the other driver's attorney sent over last Thursday regarding my rear-end collision case. My adjuster forwarded a copy and I've been reading through it over the weekend, and honestly some of it is making me nervous.

The opposing counsel leans heavily on what she describes as the controlling authority in this jurisdiction on comparative fault, and she also references what she calls the leading cases on duty of care at controlled intersections. She seems to be implying that those decisions cut against my position on contributory negligence and on the damages calculation for my future medical care.

My question for you is straightforward. Could you pull together a list of counter-cases that go the other way, with the full citations, so that Attorney Chen has everything she needs when she drafts our response? Even three or four of the strongest precedents on each issue would be enormously helpful. I'd like to send something back this week if at all possible.

I know this is the kind of work the firm normally handles, but the other side is moving fast and I want to be ready. If it's easier I can come into the office Tuesday afternoon to talk it through in person.

Thanks so much,
Marcus
